serverSettingsDescriptions.overview: Edit your server identity and essential preferences.
serverSettingsDescriptions.invites: Create secure invitations for people joining your community.
serverSettingsDescriptions.emojis: Add, rename, or remove custom emojis for your server.
serverSettingsDescriptions.members: Find members, review their roles, and manage moderation actions.
serverSettingsDescriptions.roles: Share responsibilities in your community. Set each role's appearance, permissions, and who receives it here.
serverSettingsDescriptions.bans: Review banned members and restore access when needed.
serverSettingsDescriptions.automod: Stop harmful and unwanted content before it reaches your server with Wapve Guard.
serverSettingsDescriptions.audit: Review important management and moderation activity from the last 90 days.
serverSettingsDescriptions.insights: Review member, message and activity statistics.

serverPermissionDescriptions.MANAGE_SERVER: Allows changes to the server's name, image, and essential settings.
serverPermissionDescriptions.MANAGE_ROLES: Allows members to create roles and assign them to others. Only roles below their highest role can be edited.
serverPermissionDescriptions.MANAGE_AUTOMOD: Lets members choose what Wapve Guard blocks, set exceptions, and select a channel for its records.
serverPermissionDescriptions.MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS: Opens up the community's emoji collection for additions, name changes, and removals.
serverPermissionDescriptions.USE_EXTERNAL_EMOJIS: Lets members bring emojis from other Wapve servers into this community's chats.
serverPermissionDescriptions.USE_SOUNDBOARD: Allows short sounds from the soundboard to be played during voice chats.
serverPermissionDescriptions.USE_EXTERNAL_SOUNDS: Adds access to soundboard sounds from other Wapve servers the member belongs to.
serverPermissionDescriptions.CREATE_INVITES: Lets members make invitation links to welcome new people into the community.
serverPermissionDescriptions.VIEW_AUDIT_LOG: Shows who changed what in the server, with management and moderation records from the last 90 days.
serverPermissionDescriptions.MENTION_EVERYONE: Allows notifications to the whole community with @weryone, or to members currently online with @wave.
serverPermissionDescriptions.KICK_MEMBERS: Allows members to be removed when role order permits it. A removed member can join again.
serverPermissionDescriptions.BAN_MEMBERS: Allows members to be blocked from the server and their recent messages cleared when role order permits it.
serverPermissionDescriptions.TIMEOUT_MEMBERS: Allows a member's messages, reactions, and voice participation to be paused for a set period.
serverPermissionDescriptions.MANAGE_CHANNELS: Lets members organize chat spaces by creating text and voice channels, adjusting their settings, and changing their order.
serverPermissionDescriptions.MANAGE_MESSAGES: Allows other members' messages to be deleted to keep conversations in order.
serverPermissionDescriptions.VIEW_CHANNEL: Provides access to permitted channels and messages previously posted there.
serverPermissionDescriptions.SEND_MESSAGES: Lets members take part in written conversations by sending messages.
serverPermissionDescriptions.ATTACH_FILES: Opens up photo, video, and file sharing in chat.
serverPermissionDescriptions.USE_GIFS: Lets members find and share GIFs in conversations.
serverPermissionDescriptions.ADD_REACTIONS: Lets members respond to messages with an emoji.
serverPermissionDescriptions.CREATE_POLLS: Allows polls to be started in channels to hear what the community thinks.
serverPermissionDescriptions.CONNECT: Lets members join hangouts in voice channels they can access.
serverPermissionDescriptions.SPEAK: Allows members to speak through their microphone during voice chats.
serverPermissionDescriptions.USE_CAMERA: Lets members join voice hangouts with their camera on.
serverPermissionDescriptions.SHARE_SCREEN: Allows the whole screen or a selected window to be shown during a voice chat.
